page.content:
West Baltimore park where Hae Min Lee's body was found.

How Leakin Park connects

  • Location: Baltimore — Leakin Park is in west Baltimore.
  • Character: Hae Min Lee — Hae Min Lee's body was found in Leakin Park.

What is Leakin Park?

Leakin Park is the wooded Baltimore park in which Hae Min Lee was found in February 1999, the burial site Jay Wilds described and Koenig walked for tape.

Key threads lead to Baltimore and Hae Min Lee.
